title: Annual Prepay Renewal: Saving for an Ended Orthodontic Rider (Premium Billing Accounts)
content:
**Rule.** On a Cascade Individual Annual Prepay account of Premium Billing Accounts, a rider saving is deducted from the renewal payment when the renewal invoice bills an Orthodontic Benefit Riders rider that has ended. The saving is deducted from the balance due; the total is floored at 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

- **Rider ended before the renewal start:** the renewal invoice's months covered multiplied by the rider premium.
- **Rider's termination date inside the renewal year:** the renewal year's months after the month of that date — its months covered less the whole calendar months from the renewal start to that date, less one — multiplied by the rider premium.
- **Otherwise,** or where the renewal invoice does not bill the ended rider: nothing.

Either saving is reduced by the prepay discount percentage (4 percent).

The ended rider is the orthodontic rider funded by the account whose status is terminated, the one with the latest termination date (of two with the same date, the one recorded first); its rider premium is the rider plan's monthly premium per covered person. The renewal invoice is the invoice issued last (of two issued on the same day, the one recorded first); the renewal year is its coverage months, starting with its coverage month (the renewal start) and running for its months covered, and renewal premiums are reduced by the arrangement's prepay discount percentage (4 percent on Cascade Individual Annual Prepay).

**Whether the renewal invoice bills the ended rider.** The renewal invoice is read against the plans it could bill: its premium is its months covered multiplied by the total of the monthly premiums of the plans priced, reduced by the prepay discount percentage and rounded half up to the cent. The plans priced are the subscriber's Dental PPO Plans plan; each orthodontic rider the account funds that is active or applied, at its plan's monthly premium per covered person, riders applied for after the renewal invoice's date being left out; the subscriber's Prepaid Dental HMO Plans enrollment funded by the account that is applied or active (neither terminated nor cancelled) (latest coverage effective date, the one recorded first on a tie) at its recorded tier when applied for on or before the renewal invoice's date; and the subscriber's Vision Plans enrollment funded by the account that is applied or active (neither terminated nor cancelled) (latest coverage effective date, the one recorded first on a tie, at its plan's monthly premium for its recorded tier) when applied for on or before the renewal invoice's date. The renewal invoice bills the ended rider when its amount equals, to the cent, that premium with the ended rider priced in, the dental plan being priced at the current or the former tier.
- The current tier and plan are those of the subscriber's active dental enrollment funded by the account with the latest coverage effective date (of two, the one recorded first).
- The former tier is the coverage tier recorded on the dental enrollment funded by the account of the subscriber's child, spouse or domestic partner that ended for loss of eligibility, the one with the latest termination date (of two with the same date, a child's before a spouse's or domestic partner's, and of two of one relationship the one recorded first).

This reading is made only on an account on which, for each orthodontic rider plan, its active riders and, separately, its applied riders were either all applied for on or before the renewal invoice's date or all applied for on one date, so that the records show which riders were applied for after that date (when that one date is later, those riders). On any other account the renewal invoice is taken not to bill the ended rider and no rider saving is deducted.

Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are counted the way an anniversary is counted: a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it.

**Hypothetical cases** (renewal start 1 October, 12 months; rider premium 27.35; the renewal invoice bills the ended rider).
- Rider ended 31 July: 12 multiplied by 27.35, less 4 percent: 315.072.
- Rider ended 30 November: 1 whole month from 1 October, so 12 less 1 less one, 10 months: 262.56.
